# jessica.is

> Jessica Phan is a product and brand design consultant with AI fluency and hands-on builder experience. She helps founders and teams turn ambiguity into products, brands, and meaningful experiences.

## Identity
- Name: Jessica Phan
- Site: https://jessica.is
- Role: Product & Brand Design Consultant
- Strengths: product design, brand design, AI product design, design leadership, prototyping, front-end / builder instincts
- Contact: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jessicaphan/

## What she offers
- Product design consulting for early-stage through growth teams
- Brand design for product companies
- AI-era product design guidance (strategy, UX, shipping instincts)
- Design leadership advisory
- Writing and talks on design, product, and building
